_comment: Scheduled classified emails. classification: UNCLASSIFIED | CONFIDENTIAL | SECRET | TOP SECRET. 'effects' on options are recorded but not applied until Phase 2.

emails.sender: Gen. Aurel Vance, Chief of the Defence Staff
emails.subject: Transfer of Command — Initial Briefing
emails.body:
{leader_title},

On behalf of the Defence Staff, congratulations on your investiture. As of 0600 this morning, the terminal you are reading this on is the single point of command for the armed forces and civil administration of the {nation}.

The situation you inherit is not a comfortable one:

  - The Treasury is solvent, but only just. The previous administration financed its road programme on short-term credit.
  - Civil morale is holding. The dockyards in Port Cassel are restless over wages.
  - The Vosk Hegemony continues to mass formations near the Frontier. Their intentions are unclear.

Our standing army is small and under-equipped. Understand that nothing moves quickly: a division raised today will not be fit for the line for at least two months, and every soldier in the field must be fed, fuelled and supplied every single week.

Your ministers will report through this inbox. I recommend you read each dispatch carefully before committing.

For the Commonwealth.

— A. VANCE

emails.subject: Weekly Ledger Summary — Week 1
emails.body:
LEDGER SUMMARY

Cash reserves are adequate for approximately 20 weeks at current expenditure. The standing tax rate of 18% is below the regional average.

The Treasury advises against any tax increase while the dockyard dispute remains unresolved, and against any decrease while the Frontier situation persists.

Detailed revenue forecasting is not yet available.

— Office of the Chancellor

emails.subject: Vosk Troop Concentrations — Frontier Sector
emails.body:
SOURCE RELIABILITY: B (usually reliable)

Aerial reconnaissance and a well-placed source report at least four Vosk infantry divisions and one armored formation within 40 km of the Frontier line. Rail traffic into Karzan has doubled in the last fortnight — consistent with stockpiling of fuel and munitions.

Assessment: exercise or preparation for a limited offensive. Confidence LOW.

We request authority to expand agent networks inside the Hegemony.

options.label: Authorize expansion of agent networks (-40,000 CR)
Leak the report to the press to rally the public

emails.subject: Port Cassel Dockworkers Threaten Strike
emails.body:
The Port Cassel Dockworkers' Union has issued an ultimatum: a 12% wage increase within two weeks or a general walkout.

Port Cassel handles the majority of our crude oil imports. A prolonged strike would choke fuel production within a month.

Awaiting your direction.

options.label: Declare the strike illegal; deploy gendarmerie

emails.subject: Blight Reported in Harrowfen Grain Belt
emails.body:
Agronomists report a fungal blight spreading through the Harrowfen lowlands. If unchecked, projected grain output for the season could fall by up to 30%.

Grain is the base input for military rations.

options.label: Begin civilian rationing to protect reserves
